A connection to your mail was approved on your Permaily account. The app below can read the mail it allows until it ends.

    When: 12 November 2026, 09:30 UTC
    App: An app Permaily hasn't verified
    Reads: Sender and date, subject, body text, attachments
    Through: MCP
    Ends: 10 February 2027, 09:30 UTC

You can see what it reads, and revoke it, in Connections at app.permaily.com.

If this wasn't you, sign in at app.permaily.com, revoke it in Connections, sign out the devices you don't know, and write to support@permaily.com.
